text_block_list.text:
The waiting room for the Kikuka-sho was 
mysteriously quiet.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... *Exhale*...

Yaeno Muteki is sharpening her focus 
through forms. We had discussed beforehand 
that running in the Kikuka Sho would 
require greater concentration than ever 
before.

That's because the Kikuka-sho's long 
distance makes it quite a challenge for 
Yaeno Muteki.

Her composed demeanor leaves no openings. 
None at all, and yet—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...No. Let us be on our way.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
We've been waiting for you, Yaeno!! You're 
the star of the show today!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(—Ah, this feeling. The pre-race fever 
that fires me up.)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(Breaking free of the calm, my fighting 
spirit surges...!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
(...One more move. I must fire up my 
spirit!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: âBEGONE!!" hisses!
(Ooooohhh!)

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: —Phew...

At her voice that vibrated through the 
air, I breathed a sigh of relief. Finally, 
she looked like the pre-race Yaeno Muteki 
again.

Still, it's not quite like it was during 
the Japanese Derby. A razor-sharp tension 
so intense it stole your breath away. If 
possible, I want that level of drive.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, Yaeno-chan's spirit is truly 
formidable~.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Creek-san.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I won't lose either~ To make up 
for the Derby I couldn't run in...”

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I'll be taking the Kikuka-sho.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
There's someone waiting for my victory. So 
I can't keep them waiting any longer~.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I, too, have no intention of yielding 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Yes~. Let us both do our absolute best.
